What you own and control

Infrastructure and accounts
Your business owns the equipment you buy and holds the accounts for hosting and domains. You control billing and decide who has administrator access.
Code and configuration
You keep the project code, deployment repository, and runbooks. You can use them to move the system or bring in another provider. Upstream software keeps its own license.
Data and backups
You control your data, exports, and backup storage. We test a restore using your credentials before handoff.
One project payment
You pay me once for implementation. Budget for hardware or hosting, backup storage, and the time you spend running the system.

Questions before you start

What does the one-time payment cover?

We agree on the deployment, integrations, migration, recovery checks, and training before I quote one implementation fee. You buy infrastructure and any third-party services in your name.

Will self-hosting cost less?

It depends on your current bills, the hardware or provider you choose, and who maintains the stack. Run the comparison with your own costs over one, three, or five years.

Who runs the system after handoff?

You or one person you choose can handle routine maintenance. During handoff, we practice using AI to consult the runbooks and troubleshoot errors. The person running the system checks suggestions before making changes.

Can you build a website or store in my accounts?

Yes. I can deploy a website or store in your accounts, document its integrations, and train your team to edit and operate it.

Tell me what you want to build or replace

Include the tools you use today and who will run the system after handoff.
